tools_helpful.evidence: Scaffolded the WinUI 3 target, mass-rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml and preserved the UWP csproj at .uwp-source/; migration reached full parity (score 100).
Used as the validator loop; surfaced CS0579 and nullable warnings, then confirmed BUILD SUCCEEDED after fixes (session-log turns 39-43).

tool_limitations.limitation: Copied the legacy UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs (and the background-task sub-project's AssemblyInfo.cs) into the SDK-style scaffold, which auto-generates the same assembly attributes -> CS0579 duplicate-attribute build break.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Exclude Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs from the copy step (done); document the GenerateAssemblyInfo=false fallback.

special_apis.special_handling: Run unchanged under WinAppSDK but are hardware-gated; on a machine with no accelerometer both UWP and WinUI show 'No accelerometer found' (matched behavior, not a defect). They also emit CA1416 platform-compat warnings (warnings only, build still succeeds).

errors_encountered.error: error CS0579: Duplicate 'System.Reflection.Assembly*Attribute' attribute (x6) from obj\...\BackgroundSensors.AssemblyInfo.cs
errors_encountered.root_cause: The migration copied the UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs (with [assembly: AssemblyTitle/Company/Configuration/Product/Version...]) into an SDK-style project whose GenerateAssemblyInfo default is true, so the same attributes are defined twice.
errors_encountered.fix: Added <GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo> to the csproj (session-log turn 40). Generalizable fix applied to the skill: stop copying Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1.

errors_encountered.error: CS86xx nullable warnings on Scenario1_BackgroundTask fields (Accelerometer, BackgroundTaskDeferral)
errors_encountered.root_cause: dotnet new winui scaffold enables <Nullable>enable</Nullable>; UWP source fields are not null-annotated.
errors_encountered.fix: Declared the fields nullable (Accelerometer?, BackgroundTaskDeferral?) and used Deferral?.Complete() (turns 41-42). Already covered by MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md line 166.

dev_agent_struggles.where: session-log turns 39-43 (first full build of the migrated project)
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build failed with 6x CS0579 duplicate-attribute errors
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Legacy UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs copied into an SDK-style project that auto-generates the same attributes.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 skipping Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs during the source copy (applied), so the duplicate never exists.
